name: TruthOfMarket Historical Factor Study Formula
code:
# Educational 2000-2025 Historical Dispersion Study Formula
ma20 = SMA(close, 20)
ma60 = SMA(close, 60)
low52 = MIN(low, 252)
high52 = MAX(high, 252)
vol_ratio_20d = volume / SMA(volume, 20)
regime_case = (close > ma20) AND (close > ma60) AND (MAX(vol_ratio_20d, 10) >= 1.40)
